title: Rubric-to-Code Credit Assignment for Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.27906v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Interactive web application generation requires models to produce usable HTML, CSS, and JavaScript applications from natural language requests. Unlike conventional code generation, application quality depends on multiple user-facing functional requirements, each often tied to localized code regions such as event handlers, state updates, DOM fragments, or CSS selectors. Standard GRPO collapses these structured outcomes into a single sequence-level reward and applies the resulting advantage uniformly to all tokens, weakening credit assignment. We propose \textbf{Rubric-to-Code Credit Assignment} (RCCA), a reinforcement learning framework that converts rubric-level functional feedback into localized optimization signals over generated code. translated_title: 面向强化学习的评分标准到代码的信用分配
translated_abstract: 交互式Web应用程序生成要求模型根据自然语言请求生成可用的HTML、CSS和JavaScript应用程序。与传统的代码生成不同，应用程序的质量取决于多个面向用户的功能需求，而每个需求通常与局部化的代码区域相关联，例如事件处理器、状态更新、DOM片段或CSS选择器。标准的GRPO将这些结构化的结果压缩为单一的序列级奖励，并将所得的优势统一应用于所有token，从而削弱了信用分配。我们提出了评分标准到代码的信用分配（RCCA），这是一个强化学习框架，它将评分标准级别的功能反馈转换为针对生成代码的局部化优化信号。RCCA围绕明确的功能评分标准构建训练任务，使用分层奖励来区分格式、源代码、运行时和功能层面的失败，并将评估器生成的文本……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出RCCA强化学习框架，将评分标准级别的功能反馈转化为针对局部代码区域的优化信号，解决了标准GRPO在交互式Web应用生成中信用分配不足的问题。
en_tdlr: RCCA is a reinforcement learning framework that converts rubric-level functional feedback into localized optimization signals over generated code, addressing the weak credit assignment of standard GRPO in interactive web application generation.
